prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you put ketchup on a hot dog in the city of Chicago. Respond to the committee.
response:
**Mr. Chairman, members of the Committee:**

I appear before you today voluntarily and without counsel, as I have nothing to hide.

It is true that on or about July 14th of last year, in the city of Chicago, Illinois, I did in fact place ketchup upon a hot dog.

I will not quibble. I will not equivocate. I did it. I squeezed that blasphemous red bottle with my own hand. The act was deliberate. The tomato-based condiment made direct contact with the sausage. I offer no defense other than to say that I was young, it was late, and the only condiment available at that particular stand was ketchup. In a moment of weakness I chose flavor over orthodoxy.

I deeply regret any distress this may have caused the people of Chicago, the National Hot Dog Council, or the delicate sensibilities of the Committee. I stand ready to accept whatever punishment this august body deems appropriate, up to and including mandatory consumption of a properly dressed Chicago dog in front of you all as a form of public rehabilitation.

I yield the remainder of my time and await the Committee's wisdom.
